findings.label: Duplicate import
findings.detail: Line 20 of telegram_broadcaster.py imports InlineKeyboardMarkup and InlineKeyboardButton twice in a single from-import statement. Python silently accepts this but it should be cleaned up.

findings.label: Leaderboard loop timing edge case
findings.detail: If the process starts within 5 minutes before the fire time on the target day, days_ahead stays 0 and a near-immediate post is attempted. The 6-day cooldown in post_weekly_leaderboard prevents any double-post; worst outcome is a no-op attempt with a log line.
